problems: {"itemLocator":"cards[0]","keyedAnswer":"Tributo","kind":"noCorrectOption","workedAnswer":"The distinguishing feature is that the charge does not punish an unlawful act, whereas a fine does. “Tributo” names a type of charge, not that feature: a public tariff can also be nonpunitive without being a tax. “Sanção por ilícito” describes the fine, not the charge in the stem."}
